name: How to Convert Word to PDF
description: Convert a .docx file to PDF — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your Word document
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your .docx file into the drop zone.

step.name: Convert to PDF
step.text: Click 'Convert to PDF'. Text, formatting, tables, images and lists are converted automatically — no options to configure.

step.name: Download the PDF
step.text: The PDF downloads immediately, with real selectable text — not a scanned image.
